def.zh-tw: 物體保持原來運動狀態的性質：沒有受到外力（或所受合力為零）時，靜止的物體保持靜止，運動的物體保持等速直線運動。
def.en: The tendency of an object to keep its state of motion: with no outside force (or zero net force), an object at rest stays at rest and a moving object keeps moving in a straight line at constant speed.

def.zh-tw: 克卜勒由第谷的觀測資料歸納出的三個定律：行星軌道是以太陽為一個焦點的橢圓（軌道定律）；行星與太陽的連線在相等時間內掃過相等面積（面積定律）；公轉週期的平方與軌道半長軸的立方成正比（週期定律）。
def.en: Three laws Kepler induced from Tycho's observations: a planet's orbit is an ellipse with the Sun at one focus (law of orbits); the line from the Sun to the planet sweeps equal areas in equal times (law of areas); the square of the period is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis (law of periods).
